title: Verify login with valid credentials
steps:
1. Open browser
2. Navigate to the OrangeHRM login page
3. Enter valid username in the Login Name text box
4. Enter valid password in the Password text box
5. Click the Login button
expected: User is successfully redirected to the home/dashboard page

title: Verify login with invalid username
steps:
1. Open browser
2. Navigate to the OrangeHRM login page
3. Enter invalid username in the Login Name text box
4. Enter valid password in the Password text box
5. Click the Login button
expected: Login is rejected and an appropriate error message is displayed

title: Verify login with invalid password
steps:
1. Open browser
2. Navigate to the OrangeHRM login page
3. Enter valid username in the Login Name text box
4. Enter invalid password in the Password text box
5. Click the Login button
expected: Login is rejected and an appropriate error message is displayed

title: Verify the password is masked

2. Navigate to the OrangeHRM login page

4. Enter valid password in the Password text box
